wording: Agreement: [TAG1. Teachers clearly explain when I SHOULD and SHOULD NOT use AI.]
Agreement: [TAG2. Teachers show how to verify the accuracy of information provided by AI.]
Agreement: [TAG3. Teachers show how to use AI to support thinking rather than to get answers.]
Agreement: [TAG4. Teachers give concrete examples or models of effective AI use.]
Agreement: [TAG5. When needed, I can freely discuss with teachers how to use AI for learning.]
Agreement: [AIC1. The school has clear rules or guidance on using AI for learning.]
Agreement: [AIC2. Different teachers at my school have a CONSISTENT view on using AI.]
Agreement: [AIC3. The school encourages students to use AI responsibly.]
Agreement: [AIC4. In my class/grade, students feel comfortable sharing how they use AI.]
Agreement: [AIC5. The school organizes activities that help students understand AI.]
Agreement: [RAI1. Students in my grade/class usually follow teachers' rules on AI use.]
Agreement: [RAI2. In my grade/class, copying AI-generated content verbatim for submission is rare.]
Agreement: [RAI3. Students in my grade/class usually state clearly when they used AI in their work.]
Agreement: [RAI4. Personally, I always re-check AI-generated content before using it.]
Agreement: [RAI5. Personally, I avoid using AI in assessments where it is prohibited.]
